events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $6.43 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
This is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so extra distance enters the fare and RD-2 applies in its metered branch rather than a fixed-fare branch [F7][RD-2]. The GPS record establishes one off-route segment, 21:39–21:49, covering 6.27 km where the optimal route covers 1.71 km, adding 4.56 km and reaching 1,958 m from the optimal route [F3][RD-1]. RD-1 admits no size threshold; an unexplained deviation breaches the shortest-and-most-direct duty [F1][RD-1].

RD-4 gives no cover: no incident was recorded near the route in the trip window [F14], and the only speed-band records are band 5 (40–49 km/h), which is not severe congestion and in any event band records alone cannot exempt a segment [F12][F13][RD-4]. Weather was fair [F15][RD-4].

On consent, the only rider message before the segment is the 21:36 "Sure, no problem." [F9][F10], sent before the segment started at 21:39 [F3][RD-5]. But by its words it answers a request to "pull in at the petrol station just ahead for one minute" [F8] — a stop, and no named road or route. That is not a general route choice, because it grants no discretion over the way to the destination; and it is not a route tied to the driven path: no fact ties the 21:39–21:49 segment to any named road or places the car elsewhere with rider consent [F3][RD-5]. The consent reaches a short stop only, so the driver's own route change is not covered — RD-5's third kind (scope read: a stop, not this loop) leaves the segment counting, not exempt [F3][RD-5]. The driver's "I thought a small change of route was fine" is a post-trip statement and cannot itself constitute consent [F11][RD-5].

For RD-3(a) the rider never proposed the stop and never named the place — the driver named the petrol station [F8][F9], and no stop is measured in the segment, so the segment is not exempt as a rider-named stop [F3][RD-3].

The refund is the unexcused segment's extra km at this trip's per-km rate: $26.31 ÷ 18.66 km = $1.4100/km; 4.56 km × $1.4100/km = $6.4296 ≈ $6.43 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. I do not use the $6.77 billed-excess figure (4.80 km), because RD-2 refunds only the measured unexcused segment and the ~0.24 km corridor residual is not claimed [F4][F3][RD-2]. The $0.11 waiting charge stands, since RydeTAXI waiting is metered and is not refunded [F5][RD-3]. No flag_account: the driver's 90-day upheld route-dispute count is 0, so RD-6's "repeated" condition is not met [F17][RD-6].
